Tower.authoredDescription: Hollow purple/magenta cylindrical masonry with staggered brick courses; Y is the long axis.

contract.axis: Y-up; forward -Z. Tower long axis Y; Rope long axis Z. Every GLB node is a scene root; no joints or attachments.
contract.reconstruction: Match exact Kind__Part names. Recenter each native MeshPart with sizeStuds and centerStuds, applying observed native importer Y180 conversion as in existing vehicle protocol. Preserve actual MeshId/TextureID/SurfaceAppearance and raw imported MeshSize as InitialSize. Rotation uses globalPivotStuds, never inferred mesh centre.
contract.physics: Anchored true; CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery false; Massless true. Retain original gameplay collider dimensions, positions and actions.
contract.fit: Bound all visuals. Mine/Bomb/AirMine/Spike/Icicle runs use repeated uniformly scaled templates when collider aspect ratio exceeds maxStretchRatio; avoid stretching a round mine into an elongated strip. Decks fit footprint and reference top; Tower and Rope fit declared length axis. Roles are cosmetic only.
